subject: MIDRANGE function
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (kb/Work PB62 — the ALL subscript as ONE enumerating operand with the standard's three ranges; admissibility from the definition; the summing family on the SDIDI carrier under a standard mode). `FUNCTION MIDRANGE ( { argument-1 } … )` over BOTH runtime ranges: §15.3 'If the ALL subscript is associated with a data item described with an OCCURS DEPENDING ON clause, the range of values is determined by the object of the OCCURS DEPENDING ON clause' — the range is now data-name-1's CURRENT value read at run time (AllCount.Odo → CobolTable.OdoExtent with a unit element, EC-BOUND-ODO outside integer-1..integer-2); the bind-time expansion staged this loud at run time. and 'If the subscript ALL is specified for a dynamic-capacity table, the range of values of the subscript is from 1 to the current capacity of the table' — AllCount.Capacity reads the table's register (minted for every dynamic table since PB61, named only under CAPACITY IN; a dynamic table is now a subscript LEVEL, which the former `Occurs is not null` walk never built). Golden MIDRANGE = 5.0000 (ODO), DYNMID = 20.0000 (capacity 3: 10 20 30), and NEST = 6 for a dynamic table nested in a fixed one — each outer occurrence's own capacity.
